title: DNA / Biological Sequence Analysis
short_description: Learn how biological systems compare DNA sequences, measure sequence differences, locate genetic patterns, identify palindromic segments and analyze nucleotide diversity efficiently.

real_world_context.problem: Biological research systems process large DNA sequences to identify shared genetic patterns, measure differences between sequences, locate specific nucleotide patterns, detect palindromic regions, and analyze local nucleotide diversity.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient DNA sequence analysis allows researchers to process large biological datasets and identify meaningful similarities, differences, patterns, and structural characteristics more quickly.

learning_objectives: Understand how DNA sequences can be represented using strings.
Understand how Dynamic Programming can be applied to biological sequence comparison.
Apply Longest Common Subsequence to identify shared patterns between DNA sequences.
Calculate Edit Distance to measure differences between biological sequences.
Understand how KMP efficiently locates genetic patterns within large DNA sequences.
Identify the longest palindromic segment within a DNA sequence.
Apply Sliding Window techniques to analyze nucleotide diversity in local DNA regions.
Understand how algorithm choice affects performance when processing large biological sequences.

real_world_mapping.dna_sequence: String containing nucleotides A, C, G, and T
real_world_mapping.nucleotide: Character representing A, C, G, or T
real_world_mapping.genetic_pattern: Substring to locate within a DNA sequence
real_world_mapping.palindromic_segment: Continuous DNA substring that reads identically in both directions
real_world_mapping.sequence_window: Fixed-size contiguous section of a DNA sequence

completion_message: You have completed the DNA / Biological Sequence Analysis mission. You have learned how sequence comparison, edit distance, pattern matching, palindrome detection and sliding window techniques can be applied to real-world biological sequence analysis problems.
